messages:
sam_sales: Signed today — ACME Labs (Enterprise). 3-year, Dedicated plan. I'll drop contract and initial SSO notes. Needs private deployment (VPC) and HCX connectors. Passing to CS for activation. Risk: security review may delay. @elena_cs

elena_cs: Thanks Sam. Added to onboarding queue. Key contacts: Priya (IT), Jorge (Security). Timeline ask: go-live in ~6 weeks. Logged SSO ticket #1234. I'll coordinate kickoffs and owners.

juno_success: Tagging CS enablement — need API keys, runbook, and success metrics. Owners: @elena_cs lead, @mike_eng infra. Can we get a list of integration endpoints and token expectations?

sam_sales: Endpoints: https://api.redwood.com/v1 (hosted). For private deploy we'll provide infra manifest and networking CIDRs. Sharing contract: https://files.company/ACME_contract.pdf

elena_cs: Created onboarding doc/checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/acme-labs. Initial tasks: 1) Provision org 2) SAML + SCIM setup 3) Private deploy sizing 4) Eval prompts & SLAs. Assigning owners in thread.

mike_eng: I'll take private deploy sizing and infra runbook. Need expected QPS and peak token estimate. @sam_sales can you confirm monthly tokens and burst?

sam_sales: Expected baseline ~200M tokens/month, peak bursts ~5k qps for short windows. Will attach usage appendix from procurement.

arman_support: Assigning support intake: I'll own triage first 90 days. Need on-call rotation and escalation path to eng. @mike_eng can you confirm post-deploy escalation contacts?

mike_eng: Confirmed escalation chain: me -> lead_infra -> eng_oncall. Adding runbook snippet for cache warming: ```curl -X POST https://private.acme/api/v1/cache/warm -d '{"prefix":"/conv/"}'```

juno_success: Also capture renewal risk: procurement requested 20% price cap for year 2. Track health metrics: weekly usage, error rate, latency P95. Adding to account health dashboard and renewal notes.

elena_cs: Action items (owners): - Org provisioning (elena_cs) - SAML + SCIM (elena_cs) - Private deploy sizing (mike_eng) - Networking setup (netops / ops_bot cc'd) - Success metrics dashboard (juno_success) - 90-day support (arman_support). I'll calendar invites and start the kickoff.

ops_bot: networking-ticket NT-445 created for ACME VPC peering. Responsible: netops. ETA initial config: 4 business days.

arman_support: Also request: feature flag disable-experimental-rerank for initial pilot — @mike_eng can you enable in staging?

mike_eng: Will enable the flag in staging tomorrow and run a smoke test. Will post results here.

elena_cs: :thumbsup: I'll run stakeholder kickoff next Tue. Feedback loop: weekly check-ins month 1, then biweekly. Logging renewal constraint in CRM as "price-cap-year-2".

sam_sales: Thanks team. Low risk if security review stays on schedule. Ping me if anything blocks. :pray:
